name: automaton
title: Automaton
author: zawert
description: Overhaul: belts, drills, inserters, logistic and combat robots, roboports and the offshore pump are gone — programmable automatons do their work. Write programs in TypeScript right in the game or in VS Code, or build them from nodes and wires: mining, smelting, fluids, construction, messaging, displays, combat, flying haulers.
